geopolitics.headline: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain
geopolitics.summary: The crash, between a moving train and another that was stopped further up the track, was caused by an "inexplicable" error, the transport minister said.

geopolitics.headline: Bloodied, dazed and angry - how passengers' rail journey turned to disaster in Spain
geopolitics.summary: Survivors of the train crash in Spain have spoken of their shock, panic and anger at the accident in Toledo province on Wednesday.

geopolitics.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
geopolitics.summary: The defeated Brazilian candidate claims to be the victim of a coup d’état and political persecution, recycling unsubstantiated allegations of “electoral fraud”.

geopolitics.headline: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
geopolitics.summary: With 85% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.
